about.text: We are a pioneer company in the field of students services and universities registrations. Layan Company was established in 2015,with the objective of helping foreign students to register at Turkish universities, choosing the appropriate major and providing special deduction from tuition fees. Layan company has a professional team work supporting all the students, his task is not only registering them at universities and providing acceptance but extends to satisfy all their needs from, giving any university consults then picking them from the airport and finding an appropriate shelter to finalize the residence procedures in Turkey.
about.text1: Layan is a leading provider of student services and university admissions. Teach Me Layan Company was established in 2015 as it aims to help foreign students to enroll in Turkish universities, offer distinguished study discounts, and help choose the appropriate major. Layan company has a professional team that extends its hands to all students, not only to submit student papers to the university and provide him with university admission, but to fully accommodate the student’s needs, starting from providing him with all university consultations, passing through the reception of the airport, providing him with suitable accommodation and completing all procedures for his stay in Turkey
about.text2: Our vision is to enable the student to study in Turkish universities, which constitutes an important step in the student's future due to the distinguished position of Turkish universities among the universities of the world. We extend a helping hand to the student to obtain the best level of education while providing an appropriate environment that aids excellence and creativity. We always strive to maintain our prestigious position in the field of student services and to maintain and develop the quality of service provided to students
about.text3: The company aims to teach me thank you to help foreign students to reach Turkish universities, provide them with the best study discounts and help in choosing the appropriate university major. We seek to provide all the needs of the student in Turkey and provide assistance to him through an integrated professional team
